selector.rationale: The patient's presentation of painful intertriginous wounds, linear moist eroded plaques, and ulcers in intertriginous areas is most consistent with hidradenitis suppurativa, which is a chronic skin condition characterized by recurrent, painful nodules and abscesses in apocrine-gland-bearing areas of the body.
